# Zonorah, Media Neuroscience Lab

> Zonorah is a Media Neuroscience Lab. We listen to Peruvian radio, TV and YouTube and measure what is said: open data for science, research for business.

Zonorah is a Media Neuroscience Lab. Its computational tool takes care of the media side; our research on the brain side is separate and draws on that data.

## Pages

- [English](https://zonorah.com/): home page in English
- [Español](https://zonorah.com/es/): home page in Español
- [Bahasa Indonesia](https://zonorah.com/id/): home page in Bahasa Indonesia
- [Full content as plain text](https://zonorah.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Zonorah Data](https://zonorah.com/datos/): the application (comparator, charts, CSV downloads, AI chat)

## Limits

Transcription is automatic and errs on names, acronyms and brands, so figures tend to fall short. Only what was recorded is measured, music and adverts count, and figures are rounded.

## Cite

Zonorah (2026). Memoria de los medios del Perú: minutos al aire por cada 100 horas grabadas.
